description: Step-by-step install instructions for a platform — HTML code (Consent Mode stub + banner script), the WordPress/WooCommerce plugin, the PrestaShop module, Google Tag Manager or Shoper. With a ready setup_token the code contains the real key of the account's domain; without it, YOUR_API_KEY is a placeholder and a register link is included.

hostname.description: Website hostname, e.g. example.com; defaults to the website given to create_account

locale.description: Language of the user (two-letter code): sets the language of the confirmation e-mail, the confirmation page and the CookiePilot panel, and the currency of prices ("pl" = PLN, any other = EUR). One of: en, pl, de, fr, es, it, nl, pt, sv, cs, ro, el, hu, sk, bg, hr, sl, et, lv, lt; others fall back to "en". Defaults to "en".

platform.description: Install method, usually recommendedInstallMethod from analyze_site

name: get_install_snippet
title: Get CookiePilot install instructions
